answer: Give every identity a vault that only opens after slow, verified work: earned reputation accumulates like a yarrow patch — steady, unhurried, impossible to fake overnight. In the attestation graph each identity is a vertex, and a new vertex gains weight only when vouched for by distant, unconnected vertices, never by its own cluster. A vertex caught vouching for clones loses its vault and its neighbours trust, so a Sybil farm must buy thousands of independent, long-lived reputations instead of minting them free.
